powers.title: Altar of Confinement
powers.description: You compel enemies who would flee your fury to seek comfort in their allies.
rows: Effect: You enter the altar of confinement stance. Until the stance ends, whenever you use a divine encounter or daily power, one enemy you can see that is not adjacent to any creature takes radiant damage equal to the higher of your Constitution or Intelligence.

powers.title: Death's Denial
powers.description: Your utterance prevents death from claiming new victims.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of divine power that lasts until the end of your next turn. When a nonbloodied ally within the zone becomes bloodied or drops to 0 hit points or fewer, that creature can spend a healing surge.

powers.title: Divine Call
powers.description: You intone a word of power to rally your allies to your side.
rows: Target: One or two allies
Effect: You pull each target 3 squares.

powers.title: Divine Protection
powers.description: You act knowing that your god will save you from harm.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you don't provoke opportunity attacks.

powers.title: Emissary of the Gods
powers.description: You speak with the voice of the gods, compelling others to heed your words.
rows: Effect: You gain a +5 power bonus to your next Diplomacy check or Intimidate check during this encounter. If you make this check as part of a skill challenge, you gain 2 successes if the check is successful and don't gain a failure if the check fails.

powers.title: Encouraging Chant
powers.description: You shout a word of hope to restore your allies' confidence.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of hope that lasts until the end of your next turn. While within the zone, you and any allies gain a power bonus to saving throws equal to your Intelligence.

powers.title: Heaven's Bountiful Reward
powers.description: The gods smile on your success, gifting you with renewed commitment and strength.
rows: Trigger: You drop a non-minion enemy to 0 hit points with an invoker attack power
Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: The target gains temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom.

powers.title: Know Weakness
powers.description: You utter words of power that are also words of knowledge.
rows: Effect: Choose a creature within 10 squares of you. You know that creature's current resistances and vulnerabilities, if any.

powers.title: Lore of Shom
powers.description: You invoke the vast knowledge of the lost civilization of Shom, gaining access to esoteric lore that might otherwise escape you.
rows: Trigger: You make an Arcana check, a Society check, or a Religion check and dislike the result
Effect: You reroll the skill check with a power bonus equal to your Intelligence and use either result.

powers.title: Miraculous Fortune
powers.description: Though the attack strikes you, your timely prayer reduces the worst of the injury and inspires a nearby ally.
rows: Trigger: You are damaged by an enemy's attack
Effect: The damage is reduced by 5. One ally within 5 squares of you gains a +1 power bonus to attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

powers.title: Shroud of Awe
powers.description: Your voice resonates with thunder, and you are shrouded in divine majesty that strikes awe and respect in your listeners' hearts.
rows: Effect: You can speak with a thunderous voice that allows creatures within 500 feet of you to hear you clearly. Before the end of your turn, you gain a power bonus to your next Intimidate check equal to your Constitution.

powers.title: Shroud of Warning
powers.description: You invoke the gods' protection, allowing you and your allies to act a moment sooner when combat erupts.
rows: Trigger: You and your allies roll initiative at the beginning of an encounter
Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target gains a bonus to the initiative check equal to 2 + your Intelligence.

powers.title: Wall of Light
powers.description: You transform divine energy into the form of a long, glowing wall.
rows: Effect: You conjure a wall of divine energy. The wall is 1 square high, and it lasts until the end of your next turn. While within the wall, any ally gains a +1 power bonus to AC, and each ally who starts his or her turn in the wall gains 5 temporary hit points.
Sustain Minor: The wall persists.

powers.title: Altar of Defense
powers.description: You are a shielding presence and those who fight at your side wear the armor of the gods.
rows: Effect: You enter the altar of defense stance. Until the stance ends, whenever you use an invoker encounter or daily power, one ally within 10 squares that you can see gains a +2 bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Astral Step
powers.description: You create momentary doorways through the Astral Sea, teleporting yourself and your companions a short distance.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: You teleport each target 3 squares.
Covenant of Preservation: The number of squares you teleport each target equals 3 + your Intelligence.

powers.title: Brilliant Cloak
powers.description: Your clothing comes to life with a dazzling display of color.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you and any allies adjacent to you gain a +2 bonus to AC and Reflex.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists.

powers.title: Demand Justice
powers.description: Whether an ally labors under a deadly effect or a foe seeks to escape the just end wrought by your magic, you tilt fate in your favor.
rows: Trigger: A creature within 10 squares of you makes a saving throw
Target: The triggering creature
Effect: The target rerolls the saving throw and must use the new result.

powers.title: Guardian Angel
powers.description: A prayer to the gods summons a fearsome, winged angel to protect your comrades.
rows: Effect: You conjure a guardian angel in 1 square within range. The angel lasts until the end of your next turn. Any ally in the angel's space or adjacent to it gains a +2 power bonus to AC. In addition, when you or an ally is hit by an attack while in the angel's space or adjacent to it, you can dismiss the angel as an immediate interrupt and reduce the damage by half.
Sustain Minor: The angel persists, and you can move it 5 squares.

powers.title: Patron's Blessing
powers.description: You reopen the channel to your god to facilitate divine energy's flow.
rows: Effect: You regain the use of an expended Channel Divinity power. You may use Channel Divinity a second time during this encounter.

powers.title: Prayer for Victory
powers.description: Seeing the danger, you whisper a prayer to bolster your courage in the face of harm.
rows: Trigger: An enemy makes a melee or a ranged attack roll against you
Effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to 5 + your Wisdom, and you gain a +2 power bonus to AC until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Shared Endurance
powers.description: During the ancient war, the gods stood as one against their primordial foes. Your magic can help you and your allies stand as one as well, taking wounds on one another's behalf.
rows: Trigger: An ally within 10 squares of you takes damage from an attack
Target: The triggering ally
Effect: You or an ally within 10 squares of you takes the damage from the triggering attack instead of the target, but the target takes any other effect caused by the attack.

powers.title: Shield of Light
powers.description: A flash of light flares in your enemy's eyes, disrupting its attack against your ally.
rows: Trigger: An enemy within 10 squares of you makes an attack roll against your ally
Target: The triggering enemy
Effect: The target takes a -3 penalty to the triggering attack roll. If the attack hits and deals damage, you slide the ally 1 square after the damage is dealt.

powers.title: Solid Fog
powers.description: Each word spoken carries thick fog until dense mist covers the battlefield.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of dense fog that lasts until the end of your next turn. The zone is difficult terrain and heavily obscured.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists, and you can increase its size by 1 to a maximum of blast 5.

powers.title: Symbol of Hope
powers.description: You conjure a glowing symbol of hope, which renews your allies' efforts against the enemy
rows: Effect: You conjure a symbol of hope in an unoccupied square within range. The symbol lasts until the end of your next turn. Any ally within 5 squares of the symbol gains a +2 power bonus to saving throws, and any ally who starts his or her turn within 5 squares of the symbol gains 5 temporary hit points.
Sustain Minor: The symbol persists.

powers.title: Symbol of Vengeance
powers.description: A glyph of ancient meaning shimmers above your companion, allowing you to channel your divine might to strike those that intend your companion harm.
rows: Target: One ally

Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you can determine lines of sight and effect for your divine ranged or area at-will or encounter attacks from the target, rather than from yourself, as long as you have line of sight to the target.

powers.title: Angelic Visage
powers.description: As your foe attacks, you transform into the image of a death angel. Filled with terror, the foe backs away.
rows: Trigger: An enemy within 5 squares of you makes an attack roll against you
Target: The triggering enemy
Effect: The target takes a -2 penalty to the triggering attack roll. After the attack is resolved, you push the target 3 squares.

powers.title: Call of the Vanguard
powers.description: Divine inspiration turns an ambush to your advantage.
rows: Trigger: You roll initiative
Target: You and one ally
Effect: Each target gains a bonus to his or her initiative check equal to your Intelligence. In addition, neither target is surprised.

powers.title: Cloud of Locusts
powers.description: Bloated locusts descend on the area around you, blotting out the sun with their hideous numbers.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of locusts that lasts until the end of your next turn. The zone moves with you, remaining centered on your space. Squares inside the zone are heavily obscured and whenever a creature is bloodied by an attack while inside the zone, that creature becomes dazed until the end of its next turn.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists.

powers.title: Covenant of Endurance
powers.description: You offer your life energy on your friends' behalf.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, whenever an ally within 10 squares of you has an opportunity to spend a healing surge, you can spend a healing surge on that ally's behalf as a free action. You spend the healing surge but regain no hit points, and the ally regains hit points as if he or she had spent a healing surge.

powers.title: Divine Renewal
powers.description: You fortify your allies with life-sustaining power.
rows: Target: One or two allies who each have two healing surges or fewer
Effect: Each target regains a healing surge.

powers.title: Enunciation
powers.description: Your voice raised, you extend the reach of your prayers.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you can increase the size of your close blast or close burst attacks by 1.

powers.title: Martyr's Ward
powers.description: You unleash a shield of divine energy that deflects an attack from your friend to yourself.
rows: Trigger: An ally within 10 squares of you is hit by an area or a close attack
Effect: The triggering attack hits you instead of the ally.

powers.title: Prayer of Vengeance
powers.description: You recite the ancient declaration of war against the primordials. Friends who hear it are filled with righteous indignation against their attackers.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of retribution that lasts until the end of your next turn. When any ally within the zone takes damage from an attack, that ally gains a +2 power bonus to attack rolls against the attacker until the end of the ally's next turn.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists.

powers.title: Word of Urgency
powers.description: You exclaim with authority, inspiring your friend to leap away from harm.
rows: Trigger: You use an area or a close attack power and an ally within 10 squares of you is in the area of effect
Target: The triggering ally in the burst
Effect: The target can shift a number of squares equal to your Intelligence as a free action.
